comments.value:
Same error and no previous errors, only warnings about TimelineRecording.

So I opened the package manager (under window I think) and deleted com.unity.timeline which caused an error in 

PROJECT\Packages\com.vrchat.base\Runtime\VRCSDK\Dependencies\VRChat\Scripts\Validation\WorldValidation.cs

I deleted this since it's an avatar and I don't see any reason why it'd be needed. That actually fixed it. This seems like a bug in the VRChat companion installing some files that don't belong. Please fix this.
